company.description: Company name. The website form asks for it; agent requests should include it when the person gives it.

location.description: Deprecated since 1.2.0: use siteState and siteCity. Site location for service delivery

industry.description: Deprecated since 1.2.0: put it in details. Industry classification

headcount.description: Deprecated since 1.2.0: use headcountBand. Approximate number of workers required

shiftRequirement.description: Deprecated since 1.2.0: use shiftPattern. Shift structure requirement

targetStartDate.description: Deprecated since 1.2.0: use startWindow. Preferred start date

roles.description: The work the crew will do. One or more role ids. Values: factory-helpers (Factory helpers), packing (Packing), machine-operators (Machine operators), loading-unloading (Loading and unloading), warehouse (Warehouse picking and dispatch), housekeeping (Housekeeping (factory, office, campus)), iti-trades (ITI trades (electrician, fitter, welder)), maintenance (Maintenance technicians), fabrication-civil (Fabrication and civil crews), gardening (Gardening and grounds), data-entry (Data entry and stores), forklift (Forklift operators), other (Something else).

headcountBand.description: How many workers are needed, as a band. Values: 1-9 (1 to 9 workers), 10-19 (10 to 19 workers), 20-49 (20 to 49 workers), 50-99 (50 to 99 workers), 100-249 (100 to 249 workers), 250+ (250 or more workers).

siteState.description: State or union territory of the site, as an ISO 3166-2:IN code. Values: AN (Andaman and Nicobar Islands), AP (Andhra Pradesh), AR (Arunachal Pradesh), AS (Assam), BR (Bihar), CH (Chandigarh), CG (Chhattisgarh), DH (Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu), DL (Delhi), GA (Goa), GJ (Gujarat), HR (Haryana), HP (Himachal Pradesh), JK (Jammu and Kashmir), JH (Jharkhand), KA (Karnataka), KL (Kerala), LA (Ladakh), LD (Lakshadweep), MP (Madhya Pradesh), MH (Maharashtra), MN (Manipur), ML (Meghalaya), MZ (Mizoram), NL (Nagaland), OD (Odisha), PY (Puducherry), PB (Punjab), RJ (Rajasthan), SK (Sikkim), TN (Tamil Nadu), TS (Telangana), TR (Tripura), UP (Uttar Pradesh), UK (Uttarakhand), WB (West Bengal).

siteCity.description: City, town or industrial area of the site.

sitePincode.description: Six-digit PIN code of the site.

startWindow.description: When the crew should start. Values: within-1-week (Within a week), 2-4-weeks (In 2 to 4 weeks), 1-3-months (In 1 to 3 months), planning (Just planning).

durationBand.description: How long the work is expected to last. Values: under-1-month (Under a month), 1-3-months (1 to 3 months), 3-12-months (3 to 12 months), ongoing (Ongoing (no end date)), not-sure (Not sure yet).

shiftPattern.description: Shift pattern at the site. Every shift is 8 hours. Values: general (General (one day shift)), two-shifts (Two shifts), three-shifts (Three shifts (round the clock)), night-only (Night shift only), not-sure (Not sure yet).

requestType.description: What the person is asking for: a crew (the default), a site assessment first, or help getting their own site compliant (EPF, ESIC, PT, LWF, contract labour licence, registers, minimum wage; send details and siteState). Values: crew (A crew), site-assessment (A site assessment), compliance-help (Compliance help).

pageCluster.description: Set by the website: the cluster of the page the form was opened from. Agents leave it out.

sourcePath.description: Set by the website: the page the person came from. Agents leave it out.

details.description: Anything else about the requirement: the work, the site, timings. Required when the structured requirement fields are left out.
details.example: Need housekeeping teams, fabrication fitters, and preventive maintenance support for a new line.

ContactInquiryRequest.description: Send either details, or the requirement fields roles, headcountBand, siteState, siteCity, startWindow and durationBand.

phone.description: The job seeker's 10-digit Indian mobile number. +91 or a leading 0 is accepted.

adult.description: The person told you they are 18 or older. Jobs are for adults only.

consent.description: The person agreed that Vayasya Seva may keep their details and contact them about work, under the job seeker privacy notice (https://www.vayasyaseva.com/en-in/privacy#job-seekers; in plain words, in their language: https://www.vayasyaseva.com/en-in/jobs/privacy).

text.description: About the person in their own words: name, work wanted, experience, where they live, when they can start. Never include Aadhaar, PAN or bank details.
